headline: NCT WISH's 'I SPY' tops Circle Chart's October album chart
sub: 4th mini album passes 1.64 million copies sold
source: Source: Circle Chart, Etoday, Sports World
caption:
NCT WISH's 4th mini album 'I SPY' took No. 1 on Circle Chart's monthly album chart for October.

The album had sold 1,649,000 copies on Circle Chart as of Oct 31, becoming the group's 4th straight million-seller just one day after release. NCT WISH will hold solo concerts at Seoul's Gocheok Sky Dome on Jan 15–16, both of which sold out in the fan club presale.

📌 Source: Circle Chart, Etoday, Sports World (via Korean media)
